entries.name: write: first message to a customer

output.draft:
Hi Priya, we can see your payment of ₹1,299 at 7:52 PM on 6 Oct (UTR ending 4821). Please check this in your UPI app. Our system missed your order #1234 and we're fixing it now. You'll hear from us by 8:30 PM.
Team Leafy Bakes

Priya Sharma paid ₹1,299 for a Chocolate box last night, but order #1234 is still Pending. Razorpay's plugin got the payment and dropped it. 12 in stock. Want me to mark #1234 paid and tell Priya it's confirmed?

input.reply: Got the cake today, it's lovely. Thank you!

entries.name: learn: three matching choices become a proposed rule

choices.text: Tapped Mark paid & ship on ₹850, in stock, customer confirmed
Tapped Mark paid & ship on ₹1,299, in stock, customer confirmed
Tapped Mark paid & ship on ₹1,450, in stock, customer confirmed

rule.text: When a paid order up to ₹1,500 is in stock and the customer confirms, mark it paid and ship.
